sn46.130:1.1: Pañcimani bhikkhave uddhambhāgiyani saṃyojanāni || Katamāni pañca || || Rūparāgo arūparāgo māno uddhaccam avijjā || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcuddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam abhiññaya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvetabbā || Katame satta || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti || la || upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcannam uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ime satta bojjhaṅgā bhavetabbā ti || || [Uddānam] Ogho Yogo Upādānaṃ || Gandhā Anusayena ca || || Kāma Guṇā Nīvaraṇā || Khandhā Oruddhambhāgiyānīti || || Oghavaggo terasamo
